description_text:
Note - This is not a surface model to be used in animations or video games. This is a solid model that was created in Inventor/Solidworks and is used for Mechanical design.
This a dimensionally and geometrically accurate 53ft long x 8-1/2ft wide x 9-1/2ft tall (High Cube)  ISO Shipping Container. This is the version with the double doors on one end (the other end is corrugated). This model includes accurate details for the side walls, end wall, and roof corrugations. It even includes the details for all of the underneath c-channels and details for the truck chassis area. The corner block details and geometry were modeled off of the ISO specifications and tolerances.
